title: Finite Q3 onsite weighted isometry and endpoint-to-edge bond recurrence reduction
question: Does the exact finite Q3 onsite flow preserve the two-orientation local energy-weighted seminorm, leaving only a finite endpoint-to-edge bond multiplier for the graph recurrence?

model.graph: two-site edge, four-site square face, and six-site 2x3 rectangular grid
model.local_weight: K_S=I+H_S-min(spec(H_S))I for the declared support S, with both K_S^(1/2) A K_S^(-1/2) and its reverse orientation
model.onsite_step: U_S=exp(-i delta H_S/hbar), so [U_S,K_S]=0 exactly in the finite spectral model
model.bond_step: B_e=exp(-i delta H_e/hbar) for the full registered quartic bond on edge e
model.recurrence_reduction: onsite layers are isometries; the remaining finite endpoint-to-edge multiplier is measured for both bond orientations

adversarial_review.check: The finite spectral construction checks [U_S,K_S] and both weighted orientations; no unbounded-domain identity is inferred.
The bond step uses the registered quartic bond, not only its bilinear part, and both signs are retained.
The pre-step endpoint weight and post-step edge weight are reported separately; their ratio is a finite diagnostic, not a monotonicity theorem.
Volumes 2, 4, and 6 only establish finite rows; no asymptotic uniform constant is claimed.
Oscillator dimension three is explicit and no infinite CCR or common-core closure is promoted.
Common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks the scalar weighted-conjugation identities and finite recurrence bookkeeping; it does not formalize Q3 matrices, unbounded domains, or limits.

qft_interface.closed: The finite exact-Q3 onsite layer is an isometry in the declared two-orientation local energy seminorm, and the finite recurrence can be reduced to endpoint-to-edge bond multipliers.
qft_interface.open: A source-, volume-, cutoff- and beta-uniform multiplier, common-core CCR transfer, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion independence, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

no_overclaim: Finite actual-Q3 matrix rows and the abstract commuting-weight identity do not prove a thermodynamic QFT dynamics, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, a gap, a continuum limit, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.
